title: 孩子食物过敏，怎么跟学校说？
summary: 美国学校对食物过敏非常重视。这篇教你告知过敏情况、申请免费午餐，以及问午餐安排的表达。

featuredPhrase.en: My child is allergic to peanuts.

phrases.en: My child is allergic to peanuts.
She needs to carry an EpiPen.
phrases.zh: 她需要随身带过敏急救笔。

phrases.en: Is there a free lunch program?
How do I apply for free lunch?
What's on the lunch menu this week?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hi, I need to let you know my son is allergic to peanuts.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要跟你们说一下，我儿子对花生过敏。

dialogue.speaker: School Nurse
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling us. How serious is it? Does he carry an EpiPen?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我们。严重吗？他带过敏急救笔吗？

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Yes, he has one in his backpack. His doctor filled out the allergy form.
dialogue.zh: 带的，书包里有一支。医生已经填好了过敏表格。

dialogue.speaker: School Nurse
dialogue.en: Perfect. We'll keep a copy in the cafeteria and his classroom.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我们会在食堂和他教室各留一份。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Great. One more thing — is there a free lunch program?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。还有一件事——学校有免费午餐吗？

dialogue.speaker: School Nurse
dialogue.en: Yes! I'll give you the application form. It's confidential.
dialogue.zh: 有！我给你申请表。这个是保密的。
